blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Police arrested a 24-year-old man whom they allegedly caught inside a residence in Forest Hills, Banawa, Barangay Guadalupe, Cebu City, at 12:59 a.m. on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026. Authorities identified the suspect as “Jun Niño,” a resident of Banawa. According to the initial police investigation, alias “Jason,” 23, and his sibling had just arrived home from a baptism when they discovered that the padlock on their main gate had been destroyed.
